{{Top|leg}}
{{Youmay|the [[in-universe]] conflicts|the comic ''[[Jedi: Mace Windu]]'', which was republished under the name ''Schism''}}
'''Great Schism''' referred to several different events that led to wars between traditional [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]].

==Schisms in history==
*[[First Great Schism]] — Led to the [[Legions of Lettow]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
*[[Second Great Schism]] — Led to the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]] and the exile of [[Exiles|the Dark Jedi]] to the worlds that became the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]<ref name="NEC" />
*[[Third Great Schism]] — Led to the [[Vultar Cataclysm]]<ref name="NEC" />
*[[Fourth Great Schism]] — Led to the [[New Sith Wars]] and a large Sith presence for a thousand years<ref name="The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

Although the Great Schisms were started by splits in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], which led to war or a great calamity, neither the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] started by [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] nor the [[Jedi Civil War]] started by [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] were termed Great Schisms, though they were instigated by factions from the Second Great Schism ([[Marka Ragnos]]<ref name="NEC" /> and the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]],<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> respectively).<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The third and fourth schisms remain largely untold. Their main appearances have been mostly in reference books such as the [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|Essential Guide]] series. The fourth was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization of Star Wars: The Phantom Menace]] and was originally based on background notes from [[George Lucas]] for the [[prequel trilogy]].
